necessary_context.content: Definitions 3.1–3.3 use unconstrained finite-dimensional Euclidean primal/dual spaces, a joint conditionally unbiased bounded-variance fresh gradient at one common point, initial primal gap Δ and initial dual gradient residual G. Complexity is a fixed integer raw-call budget guaranteeing primal gradient norm at most ε with probability at least 2/3 on every admissible instance and every finite dimension.
